episode_title: AviaDev Connectivity Update. 5th November 2026 with Sean Mendis and Behramjee Ghadially

real_qa.q: How much government funding did Kenya Airways receive in November 2026 and what is the money intended for?
real_qa.r: The Kenyan government made available a shareholder loan of $350 million to Kenya Airways. The intention is that this $250 million will go towards bringing the fleet back into service, complete maintenance, get parts done, and settle debts. This is necessary because between 30 and 40 percent of Kenya Airways' fleet is grounded at any given time, with the 737 fleet in particular struggling with reliability issues.

real_qa.q: What new insurance requirement did Kenya implement for travelers entering the country in October 2026?
real_qa.r: Kenya made mandatory a locally purchased $52 insurance from a Kenyan insurer as a condition to enter the country, regardless of whether travelers hold insurance from a global insurer. This follows the steps of what Tanzania and Zanzibar have done, with enforcement following Zanzibar-style rules and no exceptions. The enforcement has been sporadic at best, with inconsistent application at land borders versus airports.
real_qa.requete: Kenya $52 mandatory travel insurance requirement October 2026

real_qa.q: What conditions did South Africa's Competition Tribunal place on the Harith acquisition of FlySafair approved on October 29, 2026?
real_qa.r: The Competition Tribunal approved Harith Aviation Group's acquisition of all outstanding shares of FlySafair Operations Limited with conditions. A key condition is that Lanseria Airport, which is also owned by Harith, must make access to other airlines available on equivalent or competitive terms to what they are currently offering FlySafair. FlySafair stated that this was the last major approval required and their target is to complete the sale by the end of 2026.

real_qa.q: What strategic aviation developments is South Africa Airways seeking regarding Kenya Airways, and what legal action has SAA taken?
real_qa.r: SAA is seeking legal action against Kenya Airways for non-payment of approximately one million dollars in proceeds from a joint venture agreement. This reflects the failed strategic partnership between the two airlines, which Sean Mendis described as 'a perfect example of two alcoholics getting together in a bar to discuss how to stop drinking,' noting that you cannot expect to have economies of scale when both sides are making losses.
real_qa.requete: South African Airways Kenya Airways legal action joint venture

real_qa.q: What route launches and schedule increases did Airlink announce from Lanseria Airport in late 2026?
real_qa.r: Airlink launched Cape Town to Lanseria on December 4th with twice-daily service on the E190, planned to increase to four times daily from March 2027. Additionally, Lanseria to Harare service started at the end of November 2026. These moves represent Airlink's pivot toward Lanseria as an alternative to O.R. Tambo International Airport.
real_qa.requete: Airlink Lanseria Cape Town Harare December 2026 routes
